title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 9C: Shopping and thank-you emails
subtitle: Buying clothes, presents and emails

words.def: how big or small clothes or shoes are
words.sent: What ___ are you? Are you a large or a medium?

words.def: a small room in a shop where you try on clothes
words.sent: Where is the ___? I want to try these jeans on.

words.def: to put on clothes to see if they fit you
words.sent: Can I ___ these trousers, please?

words.def: a piece of paper that shows what you bought and how much you paid
words.sent: Keep the ___ in case you want to take the shoes back.

words.def: dark glasses that you wear when the sun is bright
words.sent: I wear ___ when it’s sunny.

words.def: a plastic card that you use to pay and pay later
words.sent: Can I pay by ___?

words.def: money in coins and notes
words.sent: This shop only takes ___, not cards.

words.def: how much something costs
words.sent: There’s no ___ on these shoes. How much are they?

words.def: not formal; comfortable to wear
words.sent: I don’t wear a suit at weekends — I wear ___ clothes.

words.def: a short coat
words.sent: It’s cold. Take your ___.

words.def: something that you give to someone, for example on their birthday
words.sent: I bought her a ___ for her birthday.

words.def: the day each year when you celebrate being born
words.sent: It’s my ___ today. I’m thirty!

words.def: sweet brown food that is often given as a present
words.sent: He gave her a box of ___.

words.def: colourful plants that you give as a present
words.sent: He gave his mother red and yellow ___.

words.def: a piece of paper that lets you go into a cinema or on a train
words.sent: Thank you for the cinema ___s!

words.def: used in serious situations, with people you don’t know well
words.sent: I use ___ words in a letter to my boss.

words.def: friendly and relaxed; used with people you know well
words.sent: I write ‘Hi Molly’ in an ___ email to a friend.

words.def: a polite word at the end of a formal email
words.sent: I end my email with ‘Best ___’.

words.def: tasting very good
words.sent: The chocolates are ___! Thank you.

words.def: to say that you are grateful to someone
words.sent: I want to ___ you for the lovely present.
